parameters.name: NodeMask
parameters.description: The MoCA Nodes that must respond to the MR transaction L2ME request sent by the NC except for the MR Entry Node (LSB corresponds to Node ID 0x0). See {{bibref|MoCAv2.0|Section 6.2.1}}

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: Time in seconds after this parameter is written that a MoCA Node must initiate a MoCA Reset (MR). See {{bibref|MoCAv2.0|Section 7.15}}.

parameters.name: StatusTrapEnable
parameters.description: Used to enable {{event|#.MrRstSuccessTrap!}} and {{event|#.MrRstFailTrap!}} that the network reset was completed successfully or failed for MR transaction status trap.

parameters.name: NetworkTrapEnable
parameters.description: Used to enable {{event|#.MrNetworkSuccessTrap!}} and {{event|#.MrNetworkFailTrap!}} that the network was reformed or not reformed successfully following the MR transaction.

object.description: Used by the managed MoCA Node to initiate MoCA Reset Transaction.
